title: Footwork Drills (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Footwork is the foundation
No good shot without good feet
Split step shuffle slide
Ready stance always ready

[Verse 1]
Split step on every contact theirs
Small hop two inches above the ground
Land soft on the toes ready
Feet apart shoulder width found
Vamos vamos feet alive
Uno dos tres feet drive
Shuffle side to side never cross
Slide for cover no loss

[Pre-Chorus]
Split and step
Slide and shuffle
Split and step
No more struggle

[Chorus]
Footwork drills footwork drills
Split step shuffle slide split step shuffle slide
Footwork drills footwork drills
Vamos amigos move with pride

[Verse 2]
Ladder drill ten minutes a day
In out in out side to side stay
Cone drill four cones in a square
Shuffle around no air no air
Uno dos tres ladder feet
Mano firme shuffle beat
Knee drive every step out
Ready stance no doubt

[Bridge]
The legs are the engine of every shot
Weak feet weak shot we forgot
Ten minutes a day on the ladder
Three weeks later you matter

[Chorus]
Footwork drills footwork drills
Split step shuffle slide split step shuffle slide
Footwork drills footwork drills
Vamos amigos move with pride

[Outro]
Split and step
Slide and shuffle
Split and step
Feet do the hustle
